_about: Every line of copy the HUD shows, in one place, so the voice is reviewed once and your agent can render it in the wearer's language. Keys are <view>.<element>[.<variant>]; each view adds its own keys (map.*, chain.*, board.*, play.*, room.*, ledger.*, turn.*, record.*). Placeholders are {name}. Rules: the word is commitment, never the older word; no contractions, the one exception the opener 'Here's the deal.'; no exclamation marks; the agent speaks in the first person, the chrome in the second. Keys beginning with _ are notes, never shown.

chain.pencil_rule: To check by hand: going forward, a card's early start is the latest early finish of what it waits on, and its early finish adds its days. Going back, its late finish is the earliest late start of what it frees, and its late start takes its days away. Days to spare is late start less early start; a card with none to spare is on the chain. Days count from the day the plan was read.
